title: ENTERPRISEPRODUCTSPARTNERSLP_07_08_1998-EX-10.3-TRANSPORTATION CONTRACT
key_points: Shipper agrees to tender commodities to Carrier for transportation by specialized services designed to meet the distinct needs of Shipper in interstate or foreign commerce between points in the United States.

Shipper agrees to pay Carrier in accordance with the Rate Appendices making reference to this contract which shall be agreed to between the parties and attached as Exhibit A, which are incorporated in this contract by reference for all purposes.
The contract shall automatically continue until terminated by either party upon not less than thirty (30) days' written notice to the other party.
Shipper is responsible for designing the points of origin and destination and any points where shipments shall be made for partial loading or unloading.

Shipper shall invoice Carrier promptly upon performance and shall pay all sums due under any invoices within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of the invoice. Amounts over $30 shall bear interest from the due date to the date of payment at the lesser of (1) the rate of interest established by Chase Manhattan Bank, New York, or (2) the maximum non-usurious interest rate which may be charged Shipper pursuant to applicable Texas law, Article 5069-1.04.
